title: How should discharge be staggered when three box furnaces share one quench tank?
summary: A Suneng proposal for three chamber quench-heating furnaces uses one rail-mounted fork manipulator to serve all three and a shared water-quench tank. Review process completion, manipulator availability, door opening and tray pickup, transfer and immersion, and tank readiness for the next batch as one sequence. Travel speed alone does not establish the quenching handover.
